verdict.rationale: The built-in web UI runs as a client against the `llama serve` HTTP API (llama-cpp-gh-2, llama-cpp-gh-3), implying the UI itself is just consuming the same API surface an AI-native user could call directly. However, the evidence pack has no explicit confirmation of full feature parity (e.g., multimodal, grammars) between UI and API, so this is inferred from architecture rather than demonstrated exhaustively.
